test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.
solution:
The correct answer is **Encyclopedia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Encyclopedia: **a book or set of books that give information about very many subjects, arranged in the order of the alphabet.

 
 
• **Example: **There are several thousand pages in the new **encyclopedia**.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Glossary: **a list of special or unusual words and their meanings, usually at the end of a text or book.
 
• **Dictionary: **a book that contains a list of the words in a language in the order of the alphabet and that tells you what they mean, in the same or another language.
 
• **Thesaurus: **a book that contains lists of words and phrases with similar meanings.
